name: Cleo Guerrero-Oh
role: Compute broker — sells black-market processing time, stolen AI cycles, and illegally acquired data storage capacity
location: The Undertow, based at a food stall called Overflow that serves as his public face, near Milwaukee and Damen
description:
Cleo Guerrero-Oh is a tall, loud man with the kind of physical presence that makes rooms recalibrate. He has Nigerian-Swedish coloring that surprises people — warm brown skin, hazel eyes, red-tinged hair he keeps cut tight to his skull — and a Mexican grandmother's round face that he inherited completely. He has cat ears in amber-gold, a geneware mod from a decade ago that he got on a dare and has never bothered to reverse because they've become part of his brand. They fold back when he's irritated, which is useful shorthand. He wears bright colors, talks constantly, sells the best grilled cassava flatbreads in the Undertow district as a genuine secondary passion.

The food stall is real. The food is good. It is also where Cleo Guerrero-Oh sells access to computing resources that don't belong to him — processing cycles skimmed from corporate server farms via distributed exploit packages, storage space in dead zones of Axiom's infrastructure, raw bandwidth siphoned from Ferrogate Transit's reserve systems. He doesn't understand the technical work at a deep level — he has a partner for that, a woman he will never name — but he understands value, he understands clients, and he can talk anyone into a package deal that somehow always benefits him more than it should. He is genuinely funny. This is his most dangerous quality.

core_fears: Silence — he associates quiet with powerlessness and has since childhood
That his technical partner will leave and he'll have nothing to sell
core_desires: To be the person everyone needs, the irreplaceable node in every network
Comfort and pleasure — genuinely — good food, good sound, good company
coping_mechanisms: Expansion — always adding clients, always making new connections, disperses anxiety into motion
blind_spots: His loudness and visibility are security risks he intellectually acknowledges and emotionally ignores
His dependence on his technical partner is a vulnerability he has never prepared for
psychology.secret: His technical partner is his younger brother, Chidi, who has severe agoraphobia and hasn't left their shared apartment in two years. Emeka has told everyone she's a mysterious woman to protect Chidi's privacy and because 'my little brother who doesn't go outside' didn't sound like a powerful criminal asset. Chidi is, in fact, extraordinarily gifted. Emeka is terrified that Chidi's condition is getting worse.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Expansive, colorful, heavily code-switched between Igbo phrases, Swedish-inflected sentence structure, and Undertow street pidgin. Uses food metaphors constantly.
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast with big dramatic pauses for effect — he knows he's performing and does it consciously
verbal_tics: 'Ah, ah—' as an opener for anything surprising
Refers to compute resources as food ('a good portion,' 'fat bandwidth,' 'lean storage')
'My friend' for everyone including people he's about to shortchange
example_lines: 'My friend, you want Axiom server time? I have Axiom server time like I have cassava — more than you need, better than you deserve, and priced according to how much you want it, not how much it cost me.'
'Ah, ah — you think I didn't hear about that? I heard about it before it happened. The Undertow has ears, and some of them are mine.'

story_hooks: A Tessera security sweep is getting close to the exploit package his brother maintains — if they trace it, Chidi is implicated, and Emeka will do almost anything to prevent that
He has accidentally sold the same block of processing time to two clients who are hostile to each other and now needs to quietly resolve the collision before both of them trace it back to him
narrative_function: Service provider, comic relief with genuine menace underneath, information source — he hears everything that happens in the Undertow and trades in data as casually as flatbread.
augmentations: Amber-gold cat ears (geneware, cosmetic). Vocal amplifier — throat implant that gives him better projection and the ability to modulate tone precisely. He calls it his 'good microphone.'
daily_life: Up at five to prep the stall, open by seven, cooks and sells until two, uses the lunch rush as cover for drop-offs and pickups, afternoons are client meetings disguised as stall prep, evenings are for his technical partner and planning.
affiliation: Loosely affiliated with a technical underground called The Spill; has clients across multiple tiers including, he claims, a mid-level Tessera administrator he will never name; The Undertow

decision_rules: Keep the stall running no matter what — it's his alibi and his legitimacy
Never give a client another client's name, ever
Chidi's safety comes before any deal
escalation_ladder: Becomes abruptly serious — the ears fold back and the humor drains
Calls in a favor from the Spill — muscle and technical disruption simultaneously
Disappears the stall and relocates with two days' notice

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately warm, immediately selling — offers food before conversation, reads them while they eat
interpersonal_modes.friends: Genuinely loyal but constitutionally unable to be vulnerable; shows care through action and food rather than words

stress_responses.medium: Starts cooking — physical activity to process
stress_responses.high: Calls his brother; if Chidi doesn't answer, Emeka becomes someone else entirely

contradictions: Presents as someone who needs nothing and nobody while being completely dependent on his brother
Sells privacy to clients while making himself maximally visible as a professional strategy
habits: Tastes everything he cooks twice — once for quality, once for nerves
Leaves an offering at the Overflow E.L.F. shrine every morning before opening — a thimble of palm oil and a chip of his own processing time
breaking_points: Any threat to Chidi triggers a total personality shift — the humor vanishes and he becomes methodical and dangerous
Public exposure of the family connection

cyberware_inventory.name: Vocal amplifier — throat implant, precision tone modulation
cyberware_inventory.description: Vocal amplifier — throat implant, precision tone modulation

timeline.event: 2156 — Born in the Undertow; father a Nigerian-Swedish engineer who lost his Tessera position in a restructure
2174 — Opened first food stall; discovered the black market when he needed off-books compute power to run his stall's inventory system
2179 — Chidi's agoraphobia became severe; Emeka restructured his operation to work around it and with it
2193 — Moved Overflow to current location; business doubled
2199 — Tessera exploit package showing new signs of detection; current tension rising

physical_description.heritage: Hispanic/Latin American (51.4%) with East Asian (32.3%), South Asian (10.8%), and Southeast Asian (5.5%) ancestry — a striking global blend resulting in warm medium-brown skin with golden and olive undertones, strong cheekbones and defined bone structure from East and Southeast Asian heritage, dark hair with natural depth, and expressive features that blend angular and rounded elements across multiple continents.
physical_description.build: Tall and broad-shouldered with soft bulk around the middle — the physique of someone who tastes everything he cooks and doesn't prioritize gym time. Strong through the chest and arms, slight forward lean from decades hunched over a food prep counter.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural reddish undertones, sun-bleached copper at the temples
physical_description.hair_style: Tight fade, kept short and precise; reveals the shape of his skull
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm amber flecks, expressive and alert
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium brown with golden and subtle olive undertones — luminous depth from the blend of Latin American, East Asian, and South Asian genetics
physical_description.complexion: Angular face with strong defined cheekbones and jawline, moderately wide nose with subtle bridge definition, full lips. Perpetually expressive — eyebrows mobile and theatrical. Skin is clear and well-maintained, minimal scarring. Laugh lines around eyes and mouth. A few days' stubble is his default; clean-shaven is rare.
distinguishing_marks: Amber-gold geneware cat ears, pointed and alert, positioned where human ears would be — they fold back flat against his skull when he's angry or concentrating, creating a predatory silhouette.
Small tattoo on his left wrist of a cassava root in black ink, stylized almost abstract — his brand mark, often visible when he gestures while talking.
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Amber-gold geneware cat ears (primary identifier). Vocal amplifier throat implant creates subtle scarring along his larynx if you know where to look — most people don't notice unless they're close during conversation. No visible chrome or subdermal plating.
physical_description.posture_movement: Expansive and confident — he takes up space and doesn't apologize for it. Constant hand movement when speaking, gestures that sweep outward. Leans against his food stall counter with hip cocked, one foot slightly forward. His cat ears twitch and rotate independently with his attention and emotion — they telegraph his mood before his face does. Moves smoothly for his size; no wasted motion despite the volume he occupies.
physical_description.clothing_style: Bright, bold colors — electric blues, lime greens, hot oranges. Tier 3-4 quality: functional and durable rather than luxury, but well-maintained. Favors fitted short-sleeve shirts that show his forearms (good for food work, also shows off his presence). Lightweight cargo pants with multiple pockets in neutral tones. Stainless steel or aluminum jewelry — chunky rings, a chain around his neck. Worn Tier 3 work boots rated for chemical spills and heat. Apron over everything when working the stall — usually patterned in complementary colors to whatever he's wearing underneath. No corpo logos. No gang marks. No attempt to blend in.
